notes.title: TY the Tasmanian Tiger 4: Bush Rescue Returns released on default branch
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Krome Studios is pleased to announce that we've made the TY the Tasmanian Tiger 4: Bush Rescue Returns release live for all users on the default branch on Steam.

A new update should download and you'll all be able to access the new update, including:
[list]
[*]Full English voice-overs featuring an all-star cast you'll recognize as TY's old mates!
[*]Remastered and updated SFX and music
[*]Improved graphics and remastered extended cutscenes as comic style animated movies
[/list]

Upon the first boot of the new build, your progress from the previous release should be applied to the new update. You will be returned to New Burramudgee and simply need to select "Keep Playing" to continue your game. 

If you should get the hankering to play the original release, we have made a permanent new beta branch called "classic" that you can use to access. Just keep in mind that progress from the new version will not be replicated in to the classic branch, and if you progress in the classic branch <its> progress will not apply to the new build on default either, without going to the options and selecting the option to re-apply the classic save game. Wow... that was a mouthful!

[b]TO REPORT BUGS[/b]
[list]
[*] Go to the game's community hub
[*] Go to the "Discussions" tab
[*] In the Sub Forums list on the right, click on the "Bug Reports" subforum - https://steamcommunity.com/app/287840/discussions/1/
[*] And post your issue there!
[*] There is a pinned post in the subforum, with some information on what would be helpful - https://steamcommunity.com/app/287840/discussions/1/6699728899094929250/
[/list]

We hope that you enjoy the new version!
Krome Studios

notes.title: TY the Tasmanian Tiger 4: Bush Rescue Returns Open Beta
notes.notes:
G'day, TY the Tasmanian Tiger fans!
 
Krome Studios is pleased to announce that there is a new OPEN BETA for TY4 which adds in Bush Rescue Returns content to Steam!

This new version adds:
[list]
[*] Full English voice-overs, featuring an all-star cast, some of whom you'll recognize as TY's old mates!
[*] Remastered and extended animated cinematics (replacing the original 'comic book' cutscenes).
[*] An improved audio experience, including some music updates and additions.
[*] More costume cosmetics added as paid DLC for $9.99... yeah-nah, just kidding - you just use in-game opals to buy them as usual.
[*] The ability to reset your save game to play again (in the Settings Menu)
[/list]
 
Now, this is an open beta, so there are a few things to note:
[list]
[*] Only 16:9 aspect ratios (eg 1280x720 or 1920x1080) look correct at the moment
[*] We haven't implemented the custom cursor icons for the mouse pointer yet
[*] There may be bugs, and there may be issues with performance - which is the point of the beta release.  If you experience any issues, we'd appreciate you letting us know!
[/list]
 
This update should keep all of your achievements, and it also should copy your progress over to the new save game format. You won't be at the <exact> same spot as your original TY4 save (you'll be on the main menu), but your major progress, unlocked costumes and rangs, and opals should carry over.

We've also implemented a "Restore" option to the Settings Menu.
Restore will <recopy> your original TY4 save game again. We've done this so that if we need to push new updates people can resume from their original save again, and also so that we don't touch the original save game at all.
This way, if you want to opt back out of the beta, you can and your save game is still there to use on the original version of the game!
 
So please - give the Open Beta a go, and let us know. There are details below on how to opt-in and where to post any issues.
 
We hope you enjoy the updates, cause we love our little orange rat, and you TY fans, too!
 
The Krome Studios Team

[b]TO OPT-IN TO THE BETA[/b]
[list]
[*] Right-click on the game in your Steam library
[*] Select 'Properties'
[*] Select the 'Betas' option on the left hand side
[*] In "Beta Participation" section, change the dropdown to the "openbeta" option
[/list]
(note - you may need to restart Steam to see this new beta, depending on when Steam was last launched)

notes.title: New patch live
notes.notes:
Hey all,

We've pushed a new patch live.
This has the following fixes:
[list]
[*] Fix for crash on launch, if the game is set to "English" in the properties of the game in Steam; and your Operating System language is set to anything other than English, French, German, Spanish, Italian or Japanese 
[*] Fixed two cases of code getting untranslated strings in the minigame select screen (name of level, etc) 
[*] Fix for crash if a ghost *just* beat you in a minigame 
[*] Fix for problem where multiple video resolutions may have gotten displayed over the top of each other 
[*] Fix in saving stats for minigames which lead to saves failing our save validation checks, causing loss of progression. 
[*] Fix for an issue with calling for Steam Leaderboards multiple times while it is downloading the leaderboard data from Steam.
[*] Fix for being able to "cheat-fly" using the power-attack move
[/list]

If there are any problems, please let us know!
Linds

notes.title: New Build on BetaTest Branch
notes.notes:
Hey all,

We've been working away on several of the reported issues, and we've popped up a new build onto the BetaTest branch, hot off the press.
These are fixes that have just been completed, and have *not* yet been rigorously tested, so you should only change to this branch if you've having a problem with one of the specific things we've fixed, or you want to give us a hand with testing the changes, and letting us know how things are.

For those people who are getting ROUTINE progression losses - please contact me at support@kromestudios.com if you are willing to try out a super-special build with some extra logging, and email us the results if/when you lose your progression. This is another special branch on Steam that we'll give you a password, to be able to access.
We've fixed ONE progression loss problem, related to if you get to the end of a minigame and exit the game without going back to the main menu, but have not been able to reproduce any other problems.

Items that are currently fixed in the beta branch, that aren't in the normal branch are:
[list]
[*] Fix for crash on launch, if the game is set to "English" in the properties of the game in Steam; and your Operating System language is set to anything other than English, French, German, Spanish, Italian or Japanese
[*] Fixed two cases of code getting untranslated strings in the minigame select screen (name of level, etc)
[*] Fix for crash if a ghost *just* beat you in a minigame
[*] Fix for problem where multiple video resolutions may have gotten displayed over the top of each other
[*] Fix in saving stats for minigames which lead to saves failing our save validation checks, causing loss of progression.
[*] Fix for an issue with calling for Steam Leaderboards multiple times while it is downloading the leaderboard data from Steam.
[/list]

If there are any issues, please let us know either on the reported issues sticky post, or by emailing support@kromestudios.com

To access the beta branch
[list]
[*] Go to your Steam Library list
[*] Right click on "TY the Tasmanian Tiger 4"
[*] select "Properties"
[*] select the "BETAS" tab
[*] select the "betatest" build from the dropdown and hit "ok"
[/list]

Cheers!
Linds

notes.title: TYme for an Update
notes.notes:
Hey all!

So we're a little over a week away from the launch of TY4 on Steam!
We're busily putting together some final touches, but everything's looking good so far.

There have been a few fairly common questions on the forums and on our Facebook pages about the game, so we thought we'd provide a little information for you...

[h1]Price Point[/h1]
[list]
[*] The game will cost $5.99USD (and equivalent prices in other terriories).
[*] The game will have a 10% launch discount.
[*] There are no microtransactions within the game (unliked the Windows 8 version). You use opals that you collect by playing the game to unlock new 'rangs and costumes (similar to how TY2 and TY3 worked)
[/list]
[h1]DLC[/h1]
[list]
[*] There will be two sets of DLC available for the game, neither of which has in-game content
[*] There will be a Soundtrack DLC, which will have all the music from TY1, TY2, TY3 and TY4. This is set up to work with the Steam music system (to allow it to be played via the Steam overlay)
[*] There will also be an artbook DLC, which has some behind the scenes concept art from the making of TY4; as a PDF.
[*] Price points are still being finalized for these, but expect something like $20USD for the soundtrack compilation and $6 for the art book, with a 10% launch discount for each.
[*] There will be a couple of different packages for buying everything grouped together, for a discounted price.
[/list]
[h1]Why TY4 or Where Is TY1/2/3?[/h1]
We've worked to bring TY4 to Steam first for a number of reasons.
[list]
[*] The game never got quite the reach that we were hoping for, from its Windows 8 release, so we're hoping that it will be picked up by a wider audience on Steam
[*] In terms of time and cost to port the game, TY4 was the easiest for us to start with. These days, Krome is a quite small independant developer, and funds are limited, so this was an important factor for us.
[*] The plan (the hope) is that TY4 will sell enough units to allow us to port TY1/2/3 over to Steam as the next step, without having a Kickstarter or similar crowd funding efforts. We may look at TY1/2/3 as Early Access, depending on how things go.
[*] In short though, TY4 needs to sell units to help us fund TY1/2/3.
[*] Any console HD-ising or handheld ports of *any* of the games are all subsequent to this - again - it depends on the sales.
[/list]
[h1]Why did you make a 2D game!?[/h1]
[*] TY has a history as a 2D game... both TY2 and TY3 had GBA versions (which were awesome by the way!)
[*] TY4 was made as a 2D game because that's the kind of game that our friends at Microsoft were after; for the launch of the Surface tablets and the Windows 8 store; and it was a great fit for the style of game that TY is.
[*] The focus of the 2D game is on the platforming (and 'rangs of course!), finding hidden collectables, and is actually pretty close to the style of gameplay that was in TY1 - just flattened onto a 2D plane.
[*] Yes, we'd love to make a new full 3D TY game. We wish that we could afford to do so! Again - we'll be watching what happens with TY4 and we'll have to see from there.
[*] Our ideal world would be that TY4 sells well enough to fund TY1/2/3 onto Steam; which sells well enough to fund making a full 3D TY5 - but honestly, we'll just have to see what happens
[/list]

We're proud of the game we made for TY4. We hope that all the TY fans and platformer fans out there like it.

Cheers everybody! Hope to see you all enjoying the game on release!

Krome

notes.title: TY4 Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
G’day fellow Bush Rescuers!

We’re so happy to get this fourth TY game on to Steam for a world-wide release – out in just over a month! 
It’s taken a bit of time to get things together for this but now many of you will finally be able to continue the adventures of TY with this ripper full-fledged TY story that continues on from the events of Night of the Quinkan.

We hope you enjoy the game when it’s released next month and that TY4 is just the first of the series to make its way to Steam! Hopefully the support we’ll get from the community from the release of TY4 will help us achieve this!

To keep up to date with all things TY, follow him on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/tythetasmaniantiger.

The Gang at Krome
